caller_evidence.surface: transcript supplement block under a final answer (files/components/sounds); sendOp catch for supplements.cancel | supplements.restart | supplements.steer

The block's own docblock says it carries NO HEADER, LABEL OR TITLE — on purpose; its frozen state line is 'Preparing highlights…' / 'Highlights cancelled' / 'Couldn't prepare highlights' (supplement-model.ts:365-367). The Canvas Files labels ui.canvas.files.highlights and ui.canvas.finder_layout.highlights (fr 'À la une') are used by finder-files-view.tsx:79 and finder-layout.ts:166, not by this key.
caller_evidence.consequence: The French must name the highlight elements of the block, not a Canvas Files section. The head value does.

caller_evidence.surface: chat sidebar bulk mark-all-read, non-deferral refusal arm
caller_evidence.detail: clearUnread() calls markAllRead(); on a failure that is not isRemoteReceiptDeferral it raises showWarningToast(t("ui.notices.chat.unread_not_cleared", { reason: userFacingMessage(failure, t("ui.notices.chat.unread_backend_silent")) })). The caller's comment states that markAllRead writes local state only from the answer's read bucket, so a refused request leaves every mark exactly where it was; the deferral arm is separate and raises the store slot instead.
caller_evidence.consequence: The second clause must say the unread state was retained. The head value does, with the locale's own 'non lues' noun.

caller_evidence.surface: success toast body for a bulk mark-all-read invocation that enumerated no items
caller_evidence.detail: markAllReadReceipt returns ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_nothing when receipt.attempted === 0. markAllRead returns attempted: 0 only when items.length === 0, after enumerating unreadAckableRows from the store: the comment says 'Nothing unread is not an empty request: items has a 1-item floor on the wire, and a batch of zero would clear nothing while still costing a round trip and a store write.' No request is sent in that branch.
caller_evidence.consequence: attempted===0 is a fact about this invocation, not a claim that no unread marks exist on screen. The head value's 'dans cette demande' encodes exactly that scope.

remediation.evidence: The head value is 'Impossible de mettre à jour les éléments à la une.' It no longer says 'la section À la une', which named the Canvas Files pane the user is not looking at. The only caller is the supplement block's cancel/restart/steer catch (supplement-row.tsx:448); that block has no header, label or title, and its elements are the highlight content. 'à la une' is the shipped French label for the 'Highlights' concept (ui.canvas.files.highlights and ui.canvas.finder_layout.highlights are both 'À la une'), so the term is consistent without re-asserting a section. The toast is raised in response to the user's action on that block, so the elements are the ones in front of them.

The head value is '{reason} Les conversations concernées restent non lues.' The calque 'marques de lecture' (marks of having read) is gone; the sentence now names the retained state from the unread side, matching ui.teamBridge's 'non lus' and the sibling ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_unknown ('elles restent non lues'). In the toast's immediate context — raised right after the mark-all-read control — the referent is unambiguous, and the sidecar explicitly asks for a request-level fact. No action.
